evidence_scope: Original documentary Agreement REFERENCES and recorded Huawei Source; requested Tdoc identity set after authored ordered witness15. All four native audit columns remain exact.
original_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'}), (a)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, a.resolutionId, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber, a.resolutionId LIMIT 15
question_en: List Huawei's TDocs that led to an agreement (tracing a company's contributions to the standard).
reference_query:
MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'}), (a)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting)
WITH a,t,c,m,[line IN split(coalesce(a.content,""),"\n") WHERE trim(line)<>""] AS lines
WITH a,t,c,m,lines,reduce(s={stopped:false,own:[],previous:"",previousHeaderRule:"",finalSeen:false},i IN CASE WHEN size(lines)=0 THEN [] ELSE range(0,size(lines)-1) END |
  CASE WHEN s.stopped THEN s
  WHEN lines[i] =~ "R1-[0-9]{7}\\t.*" THEN
    CASE
    WHEN (s.previous =~ "(?i)^.*\\bfinal\\s+CRs?\\b.*(?:in|:)\\s*:?$" OR (s.previous =~ "\\(Rel-[0-9]+,.*\\bCR[0-9]+.*\\) is (?:agreed|endorsed)\\." AND s.finalSeen)) AND i+1<size(lines) AND lines[i+1] =~ "\\(Rel-[0-9]+,.*\\bCR[0-9]+.*\\) is (?:agreed|endorsed)\\."
      THEN {stopped:false,own:s.own+[lines[i]],previous:lines[i],previousHeaderRule:"final_CR",finalSeen:true}
    WHEN s.previous =~ "(?i)^.*\\bfollowing\\s+Tdocs?\\b.*$" OR s.previousHeaderRule="explicit_following_Tdocs"
      THEN {stopped:false,own:s.own+[lines[i]],previous:lines[i],previousHeaderRule:"explicit_following_Tdocs",finalSeen:s.finalSeen}
    WHEN s.previous =~ "(?i)^.*\\bcomeback\\s+for\\s+draft\\s+LS\\b.*$" AND i+1<size(lines) AND lines[i+1] CONTAINS substring(lines[i],0,10) AND lines[i+1] =~ "(?i).*\\b(?:endorsed|approved|agreed)\\b.*"
      THEN {stopped:false,own:s.own+[lines[i]],previous:lines[i],previousHeaderRule:"draft_LS_comeback",finalSeen:s.finalSeen}
    ELSE {stopped:true,own:s.own,previous:s.previous,previousHeaderRule:s.previousHeaderRule,finalSeen:s.finalSeen} END
  ELSE {stopped:false,own:s.own+[lines[i]],previous:lines[i],previousHeaderRule:"",finalSeen:s.finalSeen} END) AS ownRecord
WHERE any(line IN ownRecord.own WHERE line =~ (".*"+t.tdocNumber+"(?![0-9]).*"))
RETURN t.tdocNumber,t.title,a.resolutionId,m.meetingNumber
ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC,t.tdocNumber,a.resolutionId LIMIT 15
